meta.description: Tier D (startups) is sourced from job boards, not a fixed company list. Each source is re-scraped every run. Sources checked 2026-10-07; those that cannot be used within the site's rules or without defeating its bot protection are kept as enabled:false with the reason.

types.rss_jsonld: RSS feed(s) list posting URLs; each posting page carries schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD (description, date, location, direct ATS url).
types.rss_browser: Public RSS feed lists postings; each job page is read with a normal Chromium browser (plain HTTP gets a bot-check there). Stops if a bot-check appears.

sources.name: Startupjobs.de
sources.notes: Verified working. Feed = 100 newest DeepTech-startup jobs; ?skills=<tag> gives filtered feeds - add more feed URLs here to widen coverage.

sources.name: Berlin Startup Jobs
sources.notes: Verified 2026-10-07: public RSS (robots.txt allows it), 12 items per page, ~3 pages. Title format 'Role // Company'. Feed text is a teaser; job pages load in plain Chromium and link to the real application page (often join.com). Many postings are German-only, which the English filter drops. Low volume (about 150 jobs open in total, newest often a week old), so max_age_days is 30; the tracker prevents repeats.

sources.name: Wellfound (AngelList) - Germany
sources.notes: Do not scrape: Wellfound's terms prohibit scraping/automated collection. Use its email job alerts instead.

sources.name: honeypot.io
sources.notes: www.honeypot.io resolves but the connection times out from the dev machine (plain HTTP and Chromium). Retry later; no public feed known.

sources.name: EU-Startups Jobs
sources.notes: Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge for scripts and headless browsers. Not bypassed. Use its job alerts or newsletter.

sources.name: Otta (now Welcome to the Jungle)
sources.notes: otta.com is now Welcome to the Jungle; its job pages return 403 to scripts and search needs login. Use its email alerts.

sources.name: tech.eu jobs
sources.notes: jobs.tech.eu now lands on the tech.eu news homepage; no job listing or feed is reachable. Revisit if the board moves.
